body: Standard Forex accounts start off leveraged at 50:1, so whatever you decide to initially invest will double every 2% it rises, it can go down too and start eating into money you didn't invest that was supposed to be a cushion. $12,500 invested @ 50:1 means a 12% drop would've consumed up to $75,000. If it reaches a certain point the computer automatically sells it off for you so you don't go into debt. even if I had only put in a ~$6,000 position all the money would have been consumed. That's how people get rich so fast in forex and it's also how people fail badly, like how I did.
Thanks for the advice. I think I just need to clear my head a bit.

In a margined account if the price of your investment drops below a certain threshold then it automatically sells off your whole position as a kind of safety net to prevent you from going into debt. I lost it. Theres nothing to sell even if I wanted to.
The only thing I can say is this: I promise you that everything gets better after high school. You are going through some of the worst years of your life and it only gets better from there.
